issues.desc: Checklist items lack userSees fields describing user-observable outcomes (CLAUDE.md requirement). Each CHK should state what the user/operator concretely sees when that item is done (e.g. CHK-001: smoke test fails on current main proving the bug; CHK-002: story_create output includes safe-init-commit confirmation, and a simulated git clean no longer wipes metadata; CHK-003: lattice doctor flags untracked INIT metadata as at-risk). Advisory only -- story scope and fix direction are correct.
